role: District Representative · Dinagat Islands, Lone District
profileLabel: Center-left economics; strongly liberal social values
summary: Dinagat Islands representative with 179 principal-authored bills. Authored SOGI anti-discrimination, same-sex couples' property rights, Safe Spaces Act amendments, a solidarity contribution on affluent Filipinos, higher alcohol excise, a wage increase and FOI strengthening; co-authored an absolute divorce bill. Pattern is consistent and progressive on both economic and social bills.
caveat: Bill authorship only; no floor votes, statements or party/bloc verified. Civil-liberties and institutions scores not assigned for lack of two distinct issues.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored solidarity contribution on affluent Filipinos (-4), a wage increase (-3), higher pay for education staff (-2) and consumption-tax relief (-1). Consistent redistributive and labor-protective pattern, financed through progressive levies.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB04304, HB00766, HB07649, HB09156, HB09134, HB05475 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Strongly liberal
social.rationale: Authored SOGI anti-discrimination (HB00765) and same-sex couples' property rights (HB08385), amended Safe Spaces Act for gender protections, co-authored absolute divorce (HB00655). Strong and consistent; evidence is bill advocacy rather than votes.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB00765, HB08385, HB00768; co-author HB00655 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

civil.label: Insufficient evidence
civil.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.

democratic.label: Insufficient evidence
democratic.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.
